# Lovastatin

**Authors:** Hanh Duong, Tushar Bajaj

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Lovastatin is a lipid-lowering medication in the statin drug class used to treat and prevent coronary heart disease, hypercholesterolemia, and adolescent patients with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia. This activity will review the mechanism of action, adverse effects, and other key factors (eg, off-label uses, dosing, pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, monitoring, relevant interactions) pertinent to the interprofessional team members in treating patients with hypercholesterolemia.
